questions.question: Let R be a point on a straight line PQ. Two Circles are drawn with diameters PR and PQ. Let A be any point on the circumference of the circle with diameter PQ. If PA meets the other circle at B, then:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

R is a point on a straight line PQ.

Two circles are drawn with diameters PR and PQ.

A is any point on the circumference of the circle with diameter PQ.

PA meets the other circle at B.

**Calculations:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7c84c9008c0b1f000bdfb77a84de42a77d073d63eb2a722f9b79186833bebc2.png] 

⇒ As A lies on the circumference of circle it makes a right angle with the diameter of circle, i.e., ∠PAQ = 90° 

⇒ Similarly, ∠PBR = 90°

As both lies on PQ line and makes 90° angle

In ∆PBR and ∆PAQ,

⇒ ∠P = ∠P (common)

⇒ ∠B = ∠A (right angle)

⇒ ∆PBR and ∆PAQ are similar triangles (By A-A property)

∴ BR ∥ AQ

⇒ BR/AQ = PR/PQ

⇒ There is no relation given between PR and PQ so, BR may not be equal to ½ AQ.

⇒ It will only be possible when R is the mid-point of line PQ.

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

⇒ (285P)/(200) - (P + (36P)/(100)) = 507 

⇒ (285P)/(200) - P - (36P)/(100) = 507

⇒ ((285P - 200P - 72P)/(200)) = 507

⇒ (13P)/(200) = 507

⇒ P = 7800

∴ The correct answer is ₹7800.

questions.question: A and B together completed a piece of work costing Rs. 1,900. A worked for 5 days, B for 6 days. If the daily wages of A and B are in the ratio of 4 : 3 respectively, then how much amount will be received by A?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total wage ratio = (A's days × A's daily wage) : (B's days × B's daily wage)

Wage ratio of A and B = (5 × 4) : (6 × 3) = 20 : 18 = 10 : 9

Total units = 10 + 9 = 19 units

Amount received by A = (10 ÷ 19) × 1900 = Rs. 1000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total cost of work = Rs. 1,900

Time taken by A = 5 days

Time taken by B = 6 days

Ratio of daily wages of A and B = 4 : 3

**Formula Used:**

Total Wage = Number of days worked × Daily wage rate

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcbf15613f2a003f45c01dad2ffc0ecf5cfb29100aef6b111723dc4ebf52ae00.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the daily wages of A and B be 4x and 3x respectively.

⇒ Total wage earned by A = 5 × 4x = 20x

⇒ Total wage earned by B = 6 × 3x = 18x

⇒ Sum of total wages = 20x + 18x = 38x

⇒ 38x = 1900

⇒ x = 1900 ÷ 38 = 50

⇒ Amount received by A = 20x = 20 × 50 = 1000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 1,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages Distribution

Wages are always distributed in direct proportion to the amount of total work done by each individual.

Equal Work Duration

If individuals work for the same number of days, their wages are distributed directly in the ratio of their efficiencies or daily wages.

Partnership Analogy

Similar to a partnership where Profit = Capital × Time, in wage distribution, Total Wage = Daily Rate × Time Worked.
</p

questions.question: The distance between two parallel chords of length 10 cm, each in a circle of diameter 12 cm, is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The circle has a diameter = 12 cm

Radius (r) = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm

Length of each chord = 10 cm

**Formula used:**

A line passing through the center perpendicularly bisect the chord into two equal parts.

Equal Chords are equal distance from the center.

**Calculation:**

Construct a circle with center 'O' and draw parallel chord AB and CD, EF is the perpendicular bisector of the chords AB and CD.

AB = CD = 10 cm, R = 6 cm

We have to find the length of EF.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a121bfdbddfcdf106df7a616160954bd7551cdc6fb22d307442dc2f426023639.png] 

In ΔBEO, ∠E is 90°, OB = 6 cm, BE = 10/2 = 5 cm,

By Pythagoras theorem

EO = (OB2 - BE2)1/2

⇒ (62 - 52)1/2

⇒ (36 - 25)1/2

⇒ sqrt{11} cm

Now, The length of the EF is

⇒ 2 × OE

⇒ 2sqrt{11} cm

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question: Aman's average score in a series of tests was ‘y’. He appeared in one more test and obtained score ‘z’. If Aman appeared in total ‘n’ tests, then which one of the following expression shows his average score for all the tests?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total number of tests taken by Aman = n.

Number of initial tests before the last one = n − 1.

Sum of scores in the first (n − 1) tests = Average × Count = y(n − 1).

Total sum of all n tests = Initial sum + Score of last test = y(n − 1) + z.

New Average = Total Sum ÷ Total Tests = [y(n − 1) + z] / n.

**∴ The correct answer is [y(n − 1) + z] / n.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of tests appeared = n

Average score in the series before the last test = y

Score obtained in the last test = z

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of Observations ÷ Nu

questions.question: A ship goes at a speed of 17 km/h downstream and at 13 km/h upstream. What will be the speed of the ship in still water?
questions.solution:

Speed of the ship downstream = 17 km/h

Speed of the ship upstream = 13 km/h

Speed in still water = (Speed downstream + Speed upstream) / 2

questions.question: The system of equations: 2x + 3y = 7 and (a - b)x + (a + b)y = 3a + b - 2 have infinitely many solutions:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For infinitely many solutions, the ratio of coefficients must be equal: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂.

⇒ 2 / (a − b) = 3 / (a + b)

⇒ 2a + 2b = 3a − 3b ⇒ a = 5b

Check options: Only Option 4 has a = 5 and b = 1, which perfectly satisfies a = 5b.

**∴ The correct answer is a = 5, b = 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

2x + 3y = 7

(a − b)x + (a + b)y = 3a + b − 2

**Formula Used:**

For a system of equations to have infinitely many solutions, the ratio of their coefficients must be equal:

a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂ = c₁ / c₂

**Calculations:**

⇒ Here, a₁ = 2, b₁ = 3, c₁ = 7

⇒ a₂ = (a − b), b₂ = (a + b), c₂ = (3a + b − 2)

⇒ 2 / (a − b) = 3 / (a + b) = 7 / (3a + b − 2)

⇒ Equating the first two parts:

⇒ 2 / (a − b) = 3 / (a + b)

⇒ 2(a + b) = 3(a − b)

⇒ 2a + 2b = 3a − 3b

⇒ a = 5b --- (Equation 1)

⇒ Equating the second and third parts:

⇒ 3 / (a + b) = 7 / (3a + b − 2)

⇒ 3(3a + b − 2) = 7(a + b)

⇒ 9a + 3b − 6 = 7a + 7b

⇒ 2a − 4b = 6

⇒ a − 2b = 3 --- (Equation 2)

⇒ Substituting a = 5b into Equation 2:

⇒ 5b − 2b = 3

⇒ 3b = 3 ⇒ b = 1

⇒ Substitute b = 1 back into Equation 1:

⇒ a = 5 × 1 = 5

**∴ The correct answer is a = 5, b = 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unique Solution

A system of linear equations has a unique solution if the lines intersect at exactly one point. The condition is a₁ / a₂ ≠ b₁ / b₂.

No Solution

A system of equations has no solution if the lines are parallel and never intersect. The condition is a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂ ≠ c₁ / c₂.

Infinitely Many Solutions

A system of equations has infinitely many solutions if the lines overlap entirely, meaning they represent the exact same line. The condition is a₁ / a₂ = b₁ / b₂ = c₁ / c₂.
</p

The length and the breadth of a rectangular field are in the ratio 3 : 2. If the area of the field is 3456 m² , then what is the cost of fencing the field at the rate of Rs.3.50 per m?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let length = 3x and breadth = 2x. Area = 6x² = 3456 ⇒ x = 24.

Perimeter = 2 × (3x + 2x) = 10x.

Total cost = Perimeter × Rate = 10x × 3.50 = 35x.

Total cost = 35 × 24 = Rs. 840.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 840.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of length to breadth = 3 : 2

Area of rectangular field = 3456 m²

Cost of fencing = Rs. 3.50 per m

**Formula Used:**

Area of Rectangle = Length × Breadth

Perimeter of Rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

Total Cost = Perimeter × Rate

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbe885e6fd773d57af5a73435e6fe5a1542f4328c2e164cf7325582a690e4074.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the length be 3x and the breadth be 2x.

⇒ Area = 3x × 2x = 6x²

⇒ 6x² = 3456

⇒ x² = 3456 ÷ 6

⇒ x² = 576

⇒ x = √576 = 24 m

⇒ Length = 3 × 24 = 72 m

⇒ Breadth = 2 × 24 = 48 m

⇒ Perimeter of the rectangular field = 2 × (72 + 48)

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × 120 = 240 m

⇒ Cost of fencing = Perimeter × Rate per m

⇒ Cost of fencing = 240 × 3.50 = Rs. 840

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 840.**

**__Additional Information__**

Area and Perimeter of Rectangle

Area represents the total space enclosed by the rectangle, calculated as Length × Breadth. Perimeter represents the total boundary length, calculated as 2 × (Length + Breadth).

Cost of Fencing vs Cost of Flooring

Fencing forms an outline along the boundary, so its cost relies entirely on the Perimeter × Rate. Flooring or tiling covers the interior surface, making its cost equal to Area × Rate.

Diagonal of a Rectangle

The length of the longest pole that can be placed straight within a rectangular room or field is its diagonal, given by the Pythagorean property: √(Length² + Breadth²).
</p

questions.question: If twice the son's age (in years) is added to the age of his father, the sum is 91. If twice the age (in years) of father is added to the age of the son, the sum is 119. What is the difference (in years) between the ages of father and son?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When coefficients of variables are swapped, subtract the smaller equation from the larger one to find the difference directly.

⇒ (2F + S) − (F + 2S) = 119 − 91

⇒ F − S = 28

**∴ The correct answer is 28 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Father's age = F years

⇒ Son's age = S years

⇒ F + 2S = 91 --- (Equation 1)

⇒ 2F + S = 119 --- (Equation 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33d5ac842d24fe1880a7d80c1a501a384929273da8897c483cf2aa02d9bb8ec2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Multiply Equation 1 by 2:

⇒ 2F + 4S = 182 --- (Equation 3)

⇒ Subtract Equation 2 from Equation 3:

⇒ (2F + 4S) − (2F + S) = 182 − 119

⇒ 3S = 63

⇒ S = 21 years

⇒ Substitute the value of S in Equation 1:

⇒ F + 2(21) = 91

⇒ F + 42 = 91

⇒ F = 91 − 42 = 49 years

⇒ Difference = F − S = 49 − 21 = 28 years

**∴ The correct answer is 28 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Swapped Coefficients Rule

For equations like ax + by = c and bx + ay = d, directly adding them easily finds (x + y), and subtracting them directly finds (x − y). This heavily bypasses complex algebraic substitution steps.

Ages Problems Concept

Always assume the present age as a variable. Past ages are represented by subtraction (x − n) and future ages by addition (x + n). The difference between the ages of two people always remains constant over time.
</p

questions.question: In a government scheme, if an electricity bill is paid before due date, one gets a reduction of 13.5% on the amount of the bill. By paying the bill before due date, Ritu got a reduction of Rs. 6,075. The amount of her electricity bill was:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

13.5% of Bill Amount = Rs. 6075

1% of Bill Amount = 6075 ÷ 13.5 = 450

100% of Bill Amount = 450 × 100 = 45000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 45,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Reduction percentage = 13.5%

Amount of reduction = Rs. 6075

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Value = (Percentage ÷ 100) × Base Value

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42814cd27c6b57e04b1ef2b958c2acb35a94a9c92a88bbea159ebe48f6ee070f.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the total amount of the electricity bill be x.

⇒ 13.5% of x = 6075

⇒ (13.5 ÷ 100) × x = 6075

⇒ x = (6075 × 100) ÷ 13.5

⇒ x = 607500 ÷ 13.5

⇒ x = 6075000 ÷ 135

⇒ x = 45000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 45,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Base and Percentage Relationship

When a specific percentage of a base value is given, the complete base value can be found directly using the relation: Base = (Given Value × 100) ÷ Percentage Rate.

Percentage Increase or Decrease

New Value = Original Value × (1 ± r ÷ 100), where r is the percentage rate of change.

Successive Percentage Change

If an amount is subjected to two successive percentage changes of a% and b%, the net effective change is calculated as: (a + b + ab ÷ 100)%.
</p

questions.question: If x is a natural number such that 18 is the third proportional to (x + 2) and (x + 6), what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

18 is the third proportional to (x + 2) and (x + 6).

**Formula Used:**

If a is the first proportional, b is the second proportional, and c is the third proportional, then:

 (a)/(b) = (b)/(c) 

**Calculation:**

Let a = (x + 2), b = (x + 6), and c = 18.

 ((x + 2))/((x + 6)) = ((x + 6))/(18) 

⇒ (x + 2) times 18 = (x + 6)² 

⇒ 18x + 36 = x² + 12x + 36 

⇒ x² - 6x = 0 

⇒ x(x - 6) = 0 

⇒ x = 0 or x = 6

Since x is a natural number, x = 6.

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

questions.question: A man sells 10 pens for ₹18 gaining 24%. How many pens should he sell for ₹1,530 to earn a profit of 55%?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the proportional ratio: (Amount ÷ Quantity) ÷ (100 + Profit%) = Constant

⇒ (18 ÷ 10) ÷ 124 = (1530 ÷ N) ÷ 155

⇒ 1.8 ÷ 124 = 1530 ÷ (155 × N)

⇒ N = (1530 × 124) ÷ (1.8 × 155)

⇒ N = 680

**∴ The correct answer is 680 pens.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP₁) of 10 pens = ₹18

Initial Profit = 24%

Target Profit = 55%

Target Amount = ₹1530

**Formula Used:**

CP = SP × [100 ÷ (100 + Profit%)]

New SP = CP × [(100 + New Profit%) ÷ 100]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a011ba95b68e2d985b3d37623573242d23ebb433b9fd48d18bc0f37b04f4b19.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SP₁ of 1 pen = 18 ÷ 10 = ₹1.80

⇒ CP of 1 pen = 1.80 × (100 ÷ 124) = ₹45/31

⇒ Target SP₂ of 1 pen for 55% profit = CP × (155 ÷ 100)

⇒ Target SP₂ = (45 ÷ 31) × (155 ÷ 100)

⇒ Target SP₂ = 45 × (5 ÷ 100) = ₹2.25

⇒ Number of pens = Total Amount ÷ Target SP₂

⇒ Number of pens = 1530 ÷ 2.25

⇒ Number of pens = 680

**∴ The correct answer is 680 pens.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP). Formula: SP = MP × [1 − (Discount% ÷ 100)].

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given, the effective single discount is (a + b − ab ÷ 100)%.

Dishonest Dealer

When a dealer sells goods at cost price but uses a false weight, the actual Profit% = [Error ÷ (True Value − Error)] × 100.

Δ PQR and Δ STU are congruent triangles under ASA. What are the values of x and y, respectively? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e79a3d49ddedf025adeae98e3d810324ff5ba44bd4fa7ecf72237b4eaf23fd67.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In congruent triangles, all corresponding angles are equal.

Since Δ PQR ≅ Δ STU, we directly compare the vertices to get ∠T = ∠Q and ∠U = ∠R.

Based on the triangle properties, ∠Q is 90°, which directly means y = 90°.

In Δ PQR, the remaining angle ∠R = 180° − (90° + 60°) = 30°.

Since ∠U = ∠R, we get x = 30°.

**∴ The correct answer is 30° and 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Δ PQR ≅ Δ STU under the ASA congruence criterion.

∠P = 60° and ∠Q = 90°

∠S = 60°, ∠T = y, and ∠U = x

**Method Used:**

The sum of interior angles in a triangle is 180°.

Corresponding parts of congruent triangles (CPCT) are always equal.

**Calculations:**

⇒ In Δ PQR, ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R = 180°

⇒ 60° + 90° + ∠R = 180°

⇒ ∠R = 180° − 150°

⇒ ∠R = 30°

Since the triangles are congruent (Δ PQR ≅ Δ STU), their corresponding angles map directly to each other:

⇒ ∠T = ∠Q → y = 90°

⇒ ∠U = ∠R → x = 30°

**∴ The correct answer is 30° and 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Congruence Criteria (ASA)

Two triangles are congruent if two angles and the included side of one are equal to the corresponding angles and included side of the other.

Angle Sum Property

The sum of all interior angles of any triangle is always exactly 180° regardless of the triangle's shape or size.

Properties of Congruent Triangles (CPCT)

When two triangles are proven to be congruent, all their corresponding angles and corresponding sides are identical in measurement.
